newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Public offer for BTA stock set for Nov 19.
newsitem.headline: Public offer for BTA stock set for Nov 19.

text.p: The special bourse session to conclude the public offer to sell (OPV) for part of the state's stake in Banco Totta & Azores (BTA) will be held on November 19, the Lisbon bourse said on Tuesday.

The government, which is selling off its 13.22 percent holding in BTA, will offer 1.6 million shares on the Lisbon bourse in separate tranches for bank employees, small investors and emigrants and the general public.
National and international institutional investors will be offered 6.3 million shares via direct sale.
Orders for the OPV can be lodged from November 6 to November 13. If demand is particularly heavy, the volume of shares to be offered through the OPV can be increased up to 15 percent.
